issues: Meaning drift: the phrase "DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA" was merged into the title line; in the original it is a separate clause following the title ("PENYELENGGARAAN ...") and should be rendered separately (e.g., "BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY").
